content.short: X Empire is a financial strategy game on Telegram where players build business empires and earn rewards.
content.description: X Empire, formerly known as Musk Empire, is a popular financial strategy game built as a Telegram Mini App. It allows players to simulate the process of building a massive business empire, rewarding them for upgrading their skills, completing social tasks, and making strategic investments. Featuring avatars inspired by prominent real-world figures, X Empire combines entertainment with Web3 incentives, onboarding millions of users to the TON ecosystem through its addictive and social-driven gameplay mechanics.
content.meta: Build your financial empire with X Empire on TON. Explore the viral strategy game on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
